undetermined.note: a0 as a direct ALU source operand (vs_1_1..vs_3_0): MS lists a0 R/W; wine allows; no instruction page says it is a legal source. Excluded from universe.
b#/i# as ALU source in vs: MS ps pages say flow-control-only, vs pages are silent. Excluded (same rule as ps).
mov to a0 (instead of mova) in vs_2_0+: MS mova page says dst must be a0; mov-to-a0 only documented for vs_1_1. Excluded.
vs_1_0/ps_1_0 via Create*Shader: not in any MS page of the D3D9 asm reference; wine d3d9 has no test, only d3d8. Included as 1_1 grammar (superset).
read of a temp written only inside if/rep: MS states the uninitialised-read validator rule for ps_1_x only; sm2/3 silent. Included.
MS vs masking page: exp/expp/log/logp/pow/rcp/rsq need a single-component write mask; ps pages silent; universe uses single-component masks plus full mask. Included.

writemask.ps14: arbitrary r,g,b,a order from 1_4; ps_1_1-1_3: .rgba .rgb .a only
